categories.name: Essential
categories.description: These cookies are strictly necessary for your website to properly function, and therefore cannot be disabled by your users.

categories.name: Functional
categories.description: These cookies are used to enhance the performance and functionality of our websites but are non-essential to their use. However, without these cookies, certain functionality (like videos) may become unavailable.

categories.name: Analytics
categories.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site.

categories.name: Marketing
categories.description: These cookies are used to make advertising messages more relevant to you. They perform functions like preventing the same ad from continuously reappearing, ensuring that ads are properly displayed for advertisers, and in some cases selecting advertisements that are based on your interests.

categories.name: Social
categories.description: These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests.

categories.name: Unclassified
categories.description: Unclassified cookies are cookies that we are in the process of classifying, together with the providers of individual cookies.
